name: watchexec
description: Universal file watcher - executes commands on file system changes with smart filtering

watchexec.description: File system watcher that executes commands when files change - supports filters and debouncing
watchexec.usage:
watchexec 'echo changed'
watchexec -w src 'cargo build'
watchexec --restart 'python app.py'
watchexec -e js,css 'npm run build'
